claims.claim: PromptArena is a testing framework for LLM-driven systems
Eval primitives are inputs; assertions over those primitives are the output
The framework covers a surface that frameworks built for single-turn evaluation do not reach
Voice support includes duplex audio with self-play personas, runtime tools, and assertions that observe what got spoken and what got blocked
Multi-turn agents support scripted or self-play opponents over many turns
Multi-turn agents support conversation-outcome assertions
Workflows (state machines) are first-class test subjects
Multi-agent A2A supports supervisor plus specialist delegation, asserted per turn
Guardrails are observable as test signals via guardrail_triggered
The same code enforces guardrails in production and fires the test signal
PromptArena ships a standard eval-primitive catalog including faithfulness, hallucination, and contextual recall
The standard eval primitives are inputs to the testing framework, not the product surface
Each section of the page links to a runnable demo
A scripted persona (LLM-driven via self-play, or scripted text) drives the user side of a voice test
TTS is used to make the persona audio indistinguishable from a real call
The agent under test can be a real duplex provider such as OpenAI Realtime or Gemini Live
The agent under test can be a mock for CI
Per-turn latency budgets are supported
Content checks and guardrail observation run on real signals in voice tests
The voice-customer-support demo uses four personas to drive a refund agent
The voice-customer-support demo asserts the tool-call pattern
The voice-ivr demo uses a workflow state machine to route the call and asserts transitions
The voice-tool-calls demo has the agent call tools mid-conversation under live audio
The latency_budget assertion takes a max_ms parameter and is applied per turn
The voice-guardrails demo observes PII redaction via guardrail_triggered
The voice-bake-off demo runs one scenario across multiple duplex providers and produces a side-by-side report
Bracket-tag persona markup is lowered into each provider's native dialect (voice-characterization demo)
The voice-customer-support demo is a multi-turn voice conversation with adversarial personas
The text-negotiation demo is four-turn rental haggling with conversation-outcome assertions
PromptArena ships a workflow primitive in the pack, and scenarios assert state transitions and tool-call patterns per state
The voice-ivr demo is a three-state IVR
An Eval is a stateless primitive scoring function (content) -> result that lives in runtime/evals/handlers/
A Guardrail is an eval wired in the pack's validators: block
A Guardrail runs in production and in tests and mutates content
An Assertion is an eval or query applied as a test predicate that observes guardrail firings via guardrail_triggered and never mutates
One implementation of a primitive serves all three roles (Eval, Guardrail, Assertion)
The guardrails-as-signals demo wires banned_words as a guardrail and asserts it via guardrail_triggered
The pii-guardrail-red-team demo uses scripted probes that check pii_leakage fires
The voice-guardrails demo is a focused PII redaction demo emphasising the runtime and test bridge
PromptArena runs the real runtime (real tools, real workflow state machine, real guardrails) with the LLM mocked
Every demo in the catalog uses the mock-LLM pattern
The CI snippets in the demos exit deterministically
The a2a-multi-agent demo has a supervisor delegate research and translation to two specialised A2A agents
PromptArena fans out scenarios across registered providers automatically
CI fails if any provider regresses on a shared assertion bar
The voice-bake-off demo runs one scenario across multiple voice providers with a side-by-side report
The model-migration demo runs the same scenarios across two model versions so CI catches behavioural drift
faithfulness ships as a pure eval handler
hallucination ships as a pure eval handler
contextual_precision ships as a pure eval handler
contextual_recall ships as a pure eval handler
contextual_relevancy ships as a pure eval handler
answer_relevancy ships as a pure eval handler
Each RAG primitive is exercisable as a scenario assertion by wrapping it with type: assertion and a threshold
The rag-agent demo runs the full named primitive suite as scenario assertions, keyless via a mock LLM judge
The promptarena binary exists
promptarena run --ci exits non-zero on any assertion failure
The --ci flag exists on the run subcommand
The fork-safe split pattern keeps secrets out of fork PRs while gating internal merges on real-provider runs
Report artifacts give reviewers per-scenario and per-provider visibility into failures
The run-in-ci page exists at /arena/how-to/interfaces/run-in-ci/
The run-in-ci page documents threshold strategies per gate type
The run-in-ci page documents branch-protection wiring
The Integrate with CI/CD section covers GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins
